target: call_sol.sh — the direct transport keeps its Responses-API body, no chat/completions fields
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -e "(has(\"response_format\") | not) and (has(\"messages\") | not)" "$D"
